Every `@eval` scenario of C005-AC-101.1, C005-AC-102.1, C005-AC-123.1, C005-AC-124.1, C005-AC-103.1, C005-AC-104.1, C005-AC-107.1 and C005-AC-114.1 other than C005-TS-156 (C005-TS-101 to C005-TS-110, C005-TS-112, C005-TS-113, C005-TS-120, C005-TS-121, C005-TS-141 to C005-TS-143, C005-TS-158 to C005-TS-163, C005-TS-173, C005-TS-174) passes on Claude Code through the Claude Code eval runner at the dev tier, at the floor of DOD-G-01, each Examples row a case of its own. C005-TS-156, the OpenCode row of C002-TS-219 restated, is carried to CHG-003 (Q-opencode-01; carry note in `.sdd/003-opencode-release/change.md`) and runs there with the OpenCode `@eval` scenarios that C002-DOD-002 moved; in CHG-005 it is closed by a DOD-G-01 waiver that P-01 decides at CHG-005's close

Every untagged scenario of `spec.md` § Acceptance (C005-TS-111, C005-TS-114 to C005-TS-119, C005-TS-122 to C005-TS-140, C005-TS-144 to C005-TS-150, C005-TS-166 to C005-TS-171, C005-TS-175 to C005-TS-179) is an automated unit or integration test that carries its TS ID and passes in `npm run check` on the release commit
The line and branch coverage of the CLI source in the `npm run check` run of the release commit meets the thresholds of C001-NFR-502

On the release commit, the body of `plugins/architect/agents/sdd-conductor.md` has at most 64,000 characters and the body of every `SKILL.md` that holds the new-change procedure or the pre-phase round rule has at most 24,000 characters (constitution, NFR defaults, Skill size)
The link to the published 0.1.1 GitHub release is recorded, with P-01's review record of C005-TS-152
The output of `npm view architect-sdd@0.1.1 version` and `npm view architect-sdd time --json` is recorded with the publish time of the 0.1.1 GitHub release, and meets C005-TS-153

P-01's review record of C005-TS-154 and C005-TS-172 on the published 0.1.1 release notes shows present the old and the new `SDD.md` sentence and, for lite plans approved with the sdd CLI 0.1.0, the statement that the first `sdd stale check` of the sdd CLI 0.1.1 sets `20-plan` stale, that one revision and one G3 approval with the sdd CLI 0.1.1 make it approved again, that before that G3 approval P-01 moves each report-field line that stands between a field line and that field's indented lines to directly after them, and that this approval holds only while every later `sdd stale check` of the change runs the sdd CLI 0.1.1

The manual check of C005-NFR-001 is recorded per shell (PowerShell 7, Command Prompt, Git Bash) with the fixture tasks and the command order of its Method, each command, its exit code and the task or defect state afterwards, and reaches 5 of 5 in each shell

A record of one manual run per `@manual-vscode` scenario (C005-TS-155 with each of its 2 Examples rows, C005-TS-157, C005-TS-164, C005-TS-165) in Copilot VS Code, with the Copilot target package 0.1.1 built from the release commit, names the VS Code and GitHub Copilot Chat versions and the date, and for each scenario gives the `askQuestions` dialog shown (screenshot or chat export), P-01's answer, the content of the files its Then steps name and the result `passed`; C005-TS-164 and C005-TS-165 may share one run

CHG-005's `20-plan` becomes stale after its re-approval because a hashing command runs the 0.1.0 plugin CLI (an `sdd-auditor` dispatch, `/architect:revise`, `/architect:gate`, `/architect:plan`, or a routine `stale check` without a change number by the conductor), or because a rollback brings the 0.1.0 hash rule back (rollback steps 1, 3, 5); `sdd archive 005` then refuses
A `src/` task commits without the rebuilt bundle; `npm run check` does not compare the bundle with `src/` (E-129), so the plugin ships stale code
Text edits move lines that tests pin (E-9, E-36), and the check fails in a later task
The hash change alters the hash of full changes or of other phases, so golden hashes and stored approvals no longer match
The lite branch of the archive runs for the first time on CHG-005 itself (E-43) and fails or misplaces files
The new-change section and the pre-phase text push the conductor's inlined skills over 64,000 characters or a skill over 24,000
Eval cases fall below the DOD-G-01 floor, or reruns push spend past the Q-budget-01 envelope
